description: The founder's moderation: takes one person out of one circle — they stop seeing its posts at once (New links stop at once; a link already opened stops working within 5 minutes.), and aren't told (the circle's creator can add them back). A circle's creator isn't removed from their own circle (suspend or delete the person instead). In Development it is done at once. In Live (env live) it asks the founder to approve it in their browser — the page names the customer and the circle — and approving it carries it out, once (live_action_status with wait: true reads the outcome). people_graph finds the circle's id. On the founder's Logs, on the person's page.
